title: Customer Security Advisory: Remote code execution vulnerability in the Apache HTTP Server's HTTP/2 module
summary: Our investigation revealed that there is no externally exposed impact on the Akamai platform/product. As of this time, we have no evidence that this vulnerability has been exploited on any Akamai platform/products. We are continuing to investigate the internal environments, and we will take appropriate remediation actions on the internal environments without impacting our customers if needed. timeline.body: Akamai is aware of the recently published remote code execution (RCE) vulnerability in the Apache HTTP Server's HTTP/2 module (CVE-2026-119618). Our subject matter experts (SMEs) are actively investigating its potential impact across our platform and infrastructure. If the vulnerability is exploited, unauthenticated remote attackers can trigger heap corruption and potentially execute arbitrary code with the privileges of the web server process. The affected versions are Apache HTTP Server versions 2.4.55 through 2.4.70 (only servers with HTTP/2 enabled are affected). We will post more details for customers and partners with a valid Control Center login at https://community.akamai.com/custome
timeline.label: investigating

timeline.body: Akamai continues to investigate the potential impact of this vulnerability across our platform and infrastructure. Akamai SMEs are taking action where necessary, and we will provide additional updates as more information becomes available. Customers and partners with a valid Control Center login can find more details at https://community.akamai.com/customers/s/feed/0D5a700001ewU8ICAU. If you have questions or are experiencing impact related to this issue, please use the Support Center on Akamai Community or Akamai Control Center to contact Akamai Technical Support. Contact information is available at https://www.akamai.com/us/en/support/.
